note: Level 99 players at their maximum job level, with the melee build and every tree skill learned. Each job is recorded without a mount and on each mount its skills allow: 'riding' (KN_RIDING, pc_setriding), 'dragon' (RK_DRAGONTRAINING, OPTION_DRAGON1), 'wug_rider' (RA_WUGRIDER, OPTION_WUGRIDER) and 'madogear' (NC_MADOLICENCE, pc_setmadogear). Each mount is tested with no weapon (weapon 0) and the lowest-ID 1H spear, 2H spear and 1H sword the job can equip. 'atkmods' is the right hand's size modifier for small, medium and large targets. 'damage' is a normal attack against Orc Warrior (1023, medium), with 'forced_min' and 'rolls' as in pc_damage.json.
